TITLE: Clarification Needed on Project Tosven's Audit and Deliverables

From: Finance Lead  
To: Project Manager  
Subject: Review of Audit Finding TE-1756-V and Budget Code GC-9642-F  

I’m following up regarding the audit finding TE-1756-V associated with Project Tosven (budget code GC-9642-F). The approved budget of $0.4M under budget code GC-9642-F is now flagged for potential overallocation based on the latest reporting. Could you confirm the current status of the deliverables from Mepoen Consulting and the timeline for equipment arrival at the Kralinan Data Center? We need to ensure that all expenditures align with the project’s scope of work before the next audit cycle.  

From: Project Manager  
To: Finance Lead  
Subject: Re: Review of Audit Finding TE-1756-V and Budget Code GC-9642-F  

Per my latest communication with Mepoen Consulting, the equipment shipment to the Kralinan Data Center is scheduled for late next week. The vendor has confirmed that all items listed in the current phase are accounted for and that the delivery will meet the project milestone. I’ll be forwarding the tracking details for your records shortly.  

Regarding the audit finding TE-1756-V, I’ve reviewed the budget code GC-9642-F and the current allocation. There is a variance due to an unexpected delay in the Mepoen Consulting contract finalization, which caused us to carry forward some line items into the next fiscal period. I’ve attached a detailed breakdown for your review. I recommend we schedule a brief meeting with the finance team to align on the documentation needed for audit closure.  

From: Finance Lead  
To: Project Manager  
Subject: Re: Review of Audit Finding TE-1756-V and Budget Code GC-9642-F  

Thank you for the clarification and the attached breakdown. I’ve shared the document with the internal audit team for review and will inform them of the pending delivery from Mepoen Consulting to the Kralinan Data Center. The variance is acceptable, but we’ll need a formal note from you regarding the deferral of funds under budget code GC-9642-F, citing the contract delay as the reason.  

I will also coordinate with the relevant team to ensure that the audit note TE-1756-V is updated with the latest status. Please confirm that the tracking information for the Mepoen Consulting equipment shipment will be available by the end of this week.  

From: Project Manager  
To: Finance Lead  
Subject: Re: Review of Audit Finding TE-1756-V and Budget Code GC-9642-F  

I’ve finalized the tracking details for the Mepoen Consulting equipment delivery to the Kralinan Data Center and will email them to you by close of business today. I’ve also drafted the variance note for budget code GC-9642-F and will send it for your review shortly.  

Let me know if the audit team requires any additional documentation or if they prefer a presentation format for the clarification.
